SCALAR_TYPES.name: Uuid
SCALAR_TYPES.rule: RFC 4122 textual form; APIs reject alternate spellings

SCALAR_TYPES.name: WalletPublicKey
SCALAR_TYPES.rule: padded base64url; decodes to exactly 32 bytes; canonical re-encode equals input; normally 44 chars

SCALAR_TYPES.name: Ed25519Signature
SCALAR_TYPES.rule: padded base64url; decodes to exactly 64 bytes; canonical re-encode equals input; normally 88 chars

SCALAR_TYPES.name: ZkzAmount
SCALAR_TYPES.rule: ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]{1,32})?$; non-negative; no sign, exponent, separators, leading zero, or trailing decimal point

SCALAR_TYPES.name: PositiveZkzAmount
SCALAR_TYPES.rule: mathematically greater than zero and at most 100000000

SCALAR_TYPES.name: UnixTimeSecsV2
SCALAR_TYPES.rule: finite non-negative decimal emitted by the wallet-compatible clock path; never converted to number after construction

SCALAR_TYPES.name: ExpiryUnixTimeSecs
SCALAR_TYPES.rule: integer seconds; request-specific protocol bounds apply

SCALAR_TYPES.name: OpaqueReference
SCALAR_TYPES.rule: limits set by API schema; never interpolated into signed SplitChain fields unless explicitly named

SOURCE: protocol scalar types; reference scalar domains; canonical amount bound
